title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-10-25
lineage: DAT (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X4 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Outstanding soundboard capture of a rare early‑era show featuring a fragment of High Time and a soaring Dark Star, with crystal‑clear audio.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced soundboard is described as “out of this world,” delivering pristine clarity that lets listeners hear every nuance of the performance. Reviewers rave about the high‑point moments – a striking Dark Star early in the set and the only surviving fragment of High Time – while noting the unique stage setup with two drummers and dual keyboards. Overall the musical content is praised as historic and compelling, making this recording a must‑listen for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews highlight excellent soundboard quality and strong musical moments; the third review, despite a 0 rating, is textually positive, so overall sentiment and quality are high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call the audio “out of this world” and commend Charlie Miller for a crystal‑clear mix; no issues or artifacts mentioned.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: One‑set show after opening acts; main set includes Cold Rain, China Cat > Rider, High Time and an early Dark Star. The stage was dark with two drummers and two keyboards, giving a distinctive early‑70s vibe.
